name: My Everyday Kale Side Salad
title: My Everyday Kale Side Salad
ingredients: 4 tightly packed cups (180 g) kale leaves
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil (, use your good stuff)
2 tsp fresh lemon juice (, or apple cider vinegar (Note 2))
1/4 tsp heaped cooking salt / kosher salt
1/4 cup flaked almonds (, toasted (if you can muster the energy) - or other nuts/seeds (Note 3))
20g/ 1.2 oz parmesan (, finely grated (small thumb-size piece, 2 1/2 tbsp very tightly packed once grated))
instructions: Massage 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper into kale, leave 30 min. Toss with remaining oil + lemon, then half almonds and parmesan. Serve, garnished with remaining almonds and parmesan.

Scrunch and massage - In a large bowl, drizzle kale leaves with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper. Scrunch handfuls of the kale leaves, massaging as you go to coat all the leaves with the oil - about 20 seconds.
Leave 30 minutes (don't skip this!) - Leave on the counter for 30 minutes to let the kale marinate. The chewy leaves will soften and the oil and salt will meld into the leaves.
Toss - Drizzle with remaining oil and all the lemon juice. Toss. Add half the almonds and parmesan. Toss.
Serve - Tumble into serving bowl. Top with remaining almonds and parmesan, then serve! Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
